subject: High School Safety and Culture Assessment
overview: The committee reviewed Fall 2022 academic assessment data and enrollment trends showing growth across the district. The meeting was marked by significant public testimony regarding a physical assault at the high school, resulting in an approved resolution to expedite a stalled climate and culture assessment.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, payroll, and minutes from the October 17, 2022 meeting.

items.title: Superintendent Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent recognized student athletic achievements in soccer, cross country, and football, and announced upcoming community events for Veterans Day and Thanksgiving.

items.title: Report on Labor Relations
items.summary: Reported that retroactive pay for five units is being implemented, while contract discussions with the Medford Teachers Association continue following a failed ratification vote.

items.title: English Learner Scholarship Project
items.summary: Announced a grant-funded partnership with UMass Boston providing graduate-level linguistics coursework for 15 teachers and paraprofessionals to obtain ESL certification.

items.title: Report on Enrollment
items.summary: Reported a total enrollment of 4,162 students, noting an increase in students returning to the district from private and charter schools.

items.title: NWEA MAP Fall Results 2022
items.summary: Academic directors presented diagnostic data showing district performance generally meets or exceeds national norms, though standard deviations indicate a need for differentiated instruction. The committee discussed test duration and how data profiles help teachers identify specific learning gaps caused by the pandemic.

items.title: Public Presentation on Student Discipline
items.summary: A parent testified regarding a violent physical assault on her daughter at Medford High School, calling for greater accountability, stricter consequences for bullies, and better victim protections.

items.title: Resolution 2022-51: Climate and Culture Assessment
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the administration to report on actions taken and delays encountered in issuing an RFP for a climate and culture assessment at the high and middle schools. The resolution was amended to specifically include assessments of bias related to disability.
